CustomField.description: Optional. The module's everyday tabs, by API name unprefixed and separated by semicolons (a page tab whose label is not its name with spaces is written Name:Label), that belong in the module's app: the app App Name names when another package ships it, none more when the module ships it, and BarnCRM Console when App Name is empty. The source deploy adds them; the Setup Assistant lists them after a package install.
CustomField.label: Staff Tabs
